task.title: To mark a clause for deletion
task.shortdesc: You'll get a message, "Your clause will be deleted on reconciliation" and the clause text

step.cmd: Go to Doc Clauses > Available Clauses list.
Search the clause you want to delete or select the clause from the available clauses list and click the more icon next to the clause name.
You will get a confirmation message, select Delete again.

result.p: You'll get a message, "Your clause will be deleted on reconciliation" and the clause text in the document is marked with a strikethrough. You can click Undo Delete from the more options next to the clause name, to remove the mark at any time in the same session.

Check-in the document and choose Reconcile. The content of the deleted clause is removed from the document and a "Deleted" entry is recorded in the Agreement Clause related list on the agreement record in Salesforce.
For more information on tracking clauses and clause activity in your agreements, refer to the Contract Management Administrator Guide for the Salesforce platform.
